summary: Reuse the existing actual-storage command-camera and camera-color leaves in the live render-command path. The camera-color output feeds COM Clear at the original color-load point after optional guard entry. Existing direct-clear callers retain their original color-pointer contract.

validation.probe_scope: A worker waits on a real Win32 critical section; the fixture changes camera+190h before releasing it, and the fake COM Clear receives the new color while guard depth/nesting are one. After return both are zero. Zero flags accept null renderer/context/camera without dereferencing them. This is synthetic stack/guard/output evidence, not gameplay.
